description: Renders an interactive first-person vision simulation (featuring a child-friendly near dog, midground streetlamp, and far mountains) directly in chat and generates shareable ArkSight deep links. Especially helpful when parents, teachers, or clinicians want to help a child express or show what they are seeing, as well as for adults exploring visual symptoms or what any of 26 eye conditions look like (e.g., cataracts, AMD, glaucoma, uveitis, astigmatism, myopia, retinal detachment, keratoconus, floaters, visual snow). Valid preset IDs: myopia, hyperopia, presbyopia, astigmatism, cataracts, uveitis, keratoconus, dry-eye, fuchs-dystrophy, keratitis, amd, diabetic-retinopathy, retinal-detachment, pvd, epiretinal-membrane, retinitis-pigmentosa, cscr, macular-hole, stargardt, retinal-vein-occlusion, glaucoma, optic-neuritis, diplopia, hemianopia, ocular-migraine, visual-snow.

blurFar.description: Distance blur on the background mountains while foreground dog stays sharp (0 to 25; myopia).

blurNear.description: Near-field blur on the foreground dog while distant mountains stay clear (0 to 25; hyperopia/presbyopia).

blurOverall.description: Overall blur across near, mid, and far distances (0 to 25; 1-10 standard, 11-25 severe).

brightness.description: Overall light brightness % (100 = normal, <100 = night blindness / optic dimming, >100 = photophobia dazzle up to 180%).

centralDarkSpot.description: Central scotoma / dark smudge at the center of gaze % (0 to 100; AMD, macular hole, Stargardt, optic neuritis).

cloudyHaze.description: Cloudy, milky lens or corneal haze washing out contrast % (0 to 100; cataracts, uveitis, Fuchs', keratitis).

compareWithNormal.description: Set true to open side-by-side comparison against clear reference sight.

contrastLoss.description: Spatial contrast sensitivity loss / washed-out faded shadows % (0 to 100; optic neuritis, cataracts, backlit glare).

curtainShadow.description: Dark curtain sweeping across vision % (0 to 100; urgent retinal detachment warning sign).

doubleVision.description: Ghosting / overlapping double vision intensity % (0 to 100; diplopia, keratoconus, astigmatism).

floaterSize.description: Floater size modifier when floaters > 0 (1 to 20, default 10).

floaters.description: Drifting dark specks, cobwebs, and rings % (0 to 100; PVD, retinal detachment, diabetic retinopathy, uveitis).

glareHalos.description: Luminous halos and starburst glare around the streetlamp % (0 to 100).

kidFriendly.description: Set true when simulating for a child or parent to enable child-friendly symptom wording.

lightFlashes.description: Peripheral arcs or flickers of light / photopsia % (0 to 100; PVD, retinal tear/detachment, ocular migraine).

migraineAura.description: Scintillating scotoma C-spiral fortification aura % (0 to 100; ocular / visual migraine).

missingPatchesGrid.description: 16-character row-major 4x4 bitmask of missing field patches ('1' = blind patch, '0' = clear; e.g. '0011001100110011' for right hemianopia).

preset.description: Optional eye condition preset slug (myopia, hyperopia, presbyopia, astigmatism, cataracts, uveitis, keratoconus, dry-eye, fuchs-dystrophy, keratitis, amd, diabetic-retinopathy, retinal-detachment, pvd, epiretinal-membrane, retinitis-pigmentosa, cscr, macular-hole, stargardt, retinal-vein-occlusion, glaucoma, optic-neuritis, diplopia, hemianopia, ocular-migraine, visual-snow). Can be combined with individual symptom overrides.

tunnelVision.description: Concentric peripheral narrowing / tunnel vision % (0 to 100; glaucoma, retinitis pigmentosa).

visualSnow.description: Fine grainy TV-like static across the visual field % (0 to 100; visual snow syndrome).

wavyDistortion.description: Metamorphopsia wavy distortion bending straight lines like the streetlamp pole (0 to 50; AMD, macular pucker/hole, CSCR).

name: simulate_vision
title: Simulate Eye Condition or Visual Symptoms
